blocks.text: With the rising cost of living and increasing prices of everyday necessities, more Filipinos are looking for practical ways to earn additional income. However, starting a business can be challenging, especially when capital is limited. ERA Nutrition offers an affordable opportunity through its innovative Protein Pops, a frozen protein snack designed for the Philippines’ tropical climate and growing health-conscious market. For just ₱35,000, aspiring entrepreneurs can start their own Protein Pops business, offering a unique product that combines nutrition, convenience, and refreshment.
